title: Mold efficiency: sixteen independent experiments
subtitle: Paired evidence, rejected revisions, and the combined result
selection_status: Complete: P1 + H1 retained as an experimental combined branch
overview: The latest-upstream experimental branch combines P1 and H1. C hello improves by 9.9% with reused outputs and 11.7% with fresh outputs. Reused-output Clang is 1.75% slower in the primary 50-pair campaign (95% interval +0.30% to +3.13%). In a later, higher-CPU state, an 80-pair repeat improves Clang by 7.5%. That conditional benefit does not erase the earlier regression.

output_mode_note: H1 is a conditional mitigation with a measurable tradeoff, not a universal large-link speedup. The same control and candidate binaries entered substantially different cost states. Historical paired results and the latest 50-pair comparisons remain visible; cases, upstream revisions, output modes, and observed states are never pooled. Both output modes use warm inputs, not cold-input benchmarks.

review_head.change: This latest-upstream candidate is the source of the current frozen performance binary. Earlier tested and measured revisions remain separate below.

validation.summary: The latest source 8e522e52 passed 8,028 integration tests across 18 target configurations, with 1,026 skips and no failures, plus all 36 unit tests. Native integration, workspace checks, formatting, and ARMv7/i686/PowerPC host compile checks passed. Latest profiling validated all 192 interval samples and the 16 final case/variant output hashes.
validation.limits: Validation and performance use the recorded source/binary identities, not moving branch heads. The earlier upstream1347 stage and its infrastructure-failure rerun remain separately documented below. Hash checks cover the last measured output of each group.

validation_history.summary: On wx-workstation, the full rerun passed 8,028 integration tests across 18 target configurations with 1,026 skips and no failures, including the new large mapped-output build-ID test in all 18 configurations. All 36 unit tests passed (34 linker, 2 test-runner). ARMv7, i686, and PowerPC host compile checks and final formatting verification passed. Output-oracle checks cover the final output of every measured case/label group. All 192 profile samples passed accounting/provenance checks; all 16 final profile outputs matched the eight case oracles.
validation_history.limits: The full suite tested 007ca03; final code revision 839f4e4b adds formatting only. An initial container run exhausted its process-ID limit and was discarded as an infrastructure failure; the complete rerun used an init process. Missing i686/PowerPC Rust standard-library targets were installed inside a disposable test container before their successful compile checks. Skips and target coverage remain visible in the full log.
